title: Hollow's Staff
summary: A +1 quarterstaff with an extra 1d4 Necrotic, stronger Necromancy saves, and level 3 Arms of Hadar.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, versatile, 5 ft melee. 1d6 + 1 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 + 1 two-handed, plus 1d4 Necrotic.
fields.Heightened Necromancy: Creatures have disadvantage on saves against your Necromancy spells. Arms of Hadar is Conjuration.
fields.Arms of Hadar: Action once per Long Rest at level 3. Creatures within 10 ft take 4d6 Necrotic. A Strength save against your spell save DC halves damage and prevents the 1-turn block on reactions that spend the Reaction resource.
fields.Topple: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Make a melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Lucretious at the Circus of the Last Days.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
